messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I'm getting an error (copied to the bottom of this post) when I try to compile my model in C++ using the compileNimble() function. I'm new to NIMBLE and to BUGS as well, so I'm hoping for some help in identifying the true source of the error. It looks like it has something to do with the usage of Eigen, perhaps because I'm indexing incorrectly? I suspect the issue is with my model code, but I'm ready for some outside perspective if someone has the time!

Here's the background: I'm trying to build a logistic regression model with 2 categorical predictors (and their interaction) with an additive random effect of temporal block. The data describe 917 replicate populations of Tribolium flour beetles. The response is extinct (1) or not extinct (0). The first predictor, "number," has 4 levels representing the number of introduction events, and the second predictor, "environment," has 2 levels representing a fluctuating or stable environment.

I’m running nimble version 0.3 and R version 3.1.3.

Please let me know if there is any other information I ought to provide.

Thanks for any help you may be able to offer,
Mike

messages.body_plain:
Michael, thanks for your interest in NIMBLE!

The problem is arising from the line in your BUGS model definition:

logit(phi[i]) <- X[i,] %*% beta[] + RE[block[i]]

Without a complete understanding myself, the matrix multiplication (%*%) is resulting in a 1x1 matrix, which is then causing problems with the rest of the expression: scalar addition and scalar assignment.

Since your "matrix multiplication" is element-wise multiplication of two vectors, I made the following change to this line of your model, which more expressly does the element-wise multiplication, then sums over the vector (giving a known scalar result).  With this change it compiled fine, so this should get you up & running.

logit(phi[i]) <- RE[block[i]]  + sum(X[i,] * beta[])

You might await or expect a more technical reply from Perry, who manages the compilation and Eigenization.  He might also suggest a more appropriate approach for you.

In the future, a *minimal* reproducible example would be much easier to work with!  Perhaps reducing the number of observations to 10, for example.

Cheers!

Daniel
NIMBLE Development Team

> On May 4, 2015, at 1:53 PM, Daniel Turek <dtu...@berkeley.edu> wrote:
>
> Michael, thanks for your interest in NIMBLE!
>
> The problem is arising from the line in your BUGS model definition:
>
> logit(phi[i]) <- X[i,] %*% beta[] + RE[block[i]]
>
> Without a complete understanding myself, the matrix multiplication (%*%) is resulting in a 1x1 matrix, which is then causing problems with the rest of the expression: scalar addition and scalar assignment.
>
> Since your "matrix multiplication" is element-wise multiplication of two vectors, I made the following change to this line of your model, which more expressly does the element-wise multiplication, then sums over the vector (giving a known scalar result).  With this change it compiled fine, so this should get you up & running.
>
> logit(phi[i]) <- RE[block[i]]  + sum(X[i,] * beta[])
>
> You might await or expect a more technical reply from Perry, who manages the compilation and Eigenization.  He might also suggest a more appropriate approach for you.
>
> In the future, a *minimal* reproducible example would be much easier to work with!  Perhaps reducing the number of observations to 10, for example.
>
> Cheers!
>
> Daniel
> NIMBLE Development Team
